reason: bind the complete Stage-1 execution, isolation, repeat, and resource mechanics after Stage-0 measured cost; no model, feature, label, quantile, policy, hypothesis, or promotion condition changes

semantic_clarifications.current_gate_KEEP: current-gate quantile 1.0 maps to positive infinity, activates no slot-10 replacement, and therefore serves the P11 incumbent
semantic_clarifications.selector_KEEP: portfolio-selector quantile 1.0 adds no supplement and preserves the already-frozen domain-local current policy bit-for-bit
semantic_clarifications.focused_source: every A_oj and T_o focused cohort is derived only from the T_o current inner-OOF policy state; the full-T_o reference policy never defines a focused cohort
semantic_clarifications.strict_evidence: T_o inner surfaces remain disclosed training-side stacking; only H_o is strict held-outer evidence

full_retrain_rule.stage0_reuse: Stage-0 models and scores are a mechanical parity oracle only and do not count toward either Stage-1 pass
full_retrain_rule.first_pass_reuse: no model, fitted head, score, choice, cohort, probability, utility, threshold, or policy array from first may be reused by repeat
full_retrain_rule.allowed_shared_inputs: the sealed raw/projected tensors, fold metadata, one per-worker T_o selected-row materialization, and frozen source/config files

worker_isolation.unit: one (pass, outer_fold) worker and one new exclusive output directory
worker_isolation.order: workers run sequentially; XGBoost nthread=1; no cross-outer parallelism
worker_isolation.label_scope: the worker retains only T_o outcome slices; compressed NPZ member decompression may transiently include H_o bytes, but no H_o outcome is indexed into a retained array, supplied to fit/selection/metric code, or serialized
worker_isolation.held_builder: H_o current and portfolio surfaces are inference-only interfaces with no label argument
worker_isolation.completion: write outer_complete.json last; partial attempts are never overwritten or treated as complete

current_policy_mechanics.ranker_oof: five current A_oj models score their disjoint V_oj and cover T_o exactly once
current_policy_mechanics.inner_quantile: select on current-gate OOF utility with the frozen 0/64..63/64 plus KEEP grid
current_policy_mechanics.full_heads: fit both heads only on T_o current-ranker OOF action rows
current_policy_mechanics.reference_mapping: score the full-T_o current ranker and heads on target-free T_o reference rows; map the selected quantile over T_o reference action utility with the frozen higher method
current_policy_mechanics.held_application: apply the one mapped reference threshold to H_o utility without refit, remap, labels, state, or outcome metric

focused_mechanics.superset: materialize one ordered T_o focused cohort/cache from the T_o current OOF state
focused_mechanics.partitions: each A_oj selects cohort groups whose session is in A_oj; T_o selects all groups
focused_mechanics.weights: recompute frozen within-session and exact 50/50 hard-control weights inside every actual partition
focused_mechanics.fail_closed: all 30 focused training partitions require nonempty hard and control cohorts

portfolio_selector_mechanics.runtime_features: preserve valid-input numeric and decision parity with the frozen v2.7 19-feature computation while removing its hard-coded 2,000-session shape assumption
portfolio_selector_mechanics.python39_compatibility: the pinned training environment cannot import the v2.7 reporting dependency chain; a hash-pinned local subset copies only used selector/supplemental helpers, omits report/evaluator imports, replaces int.bit_count with the equivalent bin(value).count('1'), retains explicit shape guards, and changes no valid-input numeric or policy semantics; exception class identity is not claimed
portfolio_selector_mechanics.training_surface: T_o uses A_oj-to-V_oj OOF current, pairwise, RRF3, and focused scores; isolated labels are attached only after slicing this T_o runtime surface
portfolio_selector_mechanics.reference_surface: T_o uses the five full-T_o ranker scores and domain-local current reference activation
portfolio_selector_mechanics.held_surface: H_o uses the same five full-T_o ranker scores and the already-mapped domain-local current held activation
portfolio_selector_mechanics.model: the frozen v2.7 C=0.2 liblinear L2 two-head selector; readiness, weights, utility, tie-break, quantile grid, selection key, and chronological latch are unchanged
portfolio_selector_mechanics.reference_mapping: fit full selector heads on T_o OOF actions, score target-free T_o reference and H_o actions, map selected q over T_o reference per-turn winners, then apply once to H_o
portfolio_selector_mechanics.KEEP_or_readiness_failure: do not fit outer selector heads and preserve domain-local current on H_o

freeze_and_outcome_boundary.cache_first: both complete 150-model passes must be frozen and canonical identities must match exactly before outcome access
freeze_and_outcome_boundary.repeat_identity_includes: all domain masks and lineage, model params/seeds/rounds and JSON hashes, score/choice arrays, current gate surfaces/heads/probabilities/utilities/q/thresholds/activation, focused cohorts/partition weights, RRF, all portfolio runtime and supervised fields, selector heads/probabilities/utilities/q/reference threshold, and held final arrays
freeze_and_outcome_boundary.held_stitch: the five H_o shards cover every session exactly once
freeze_and_outcome_boundary.outcome: a separate one-shot command attaches labels once and computes primary final-vs-domain-local-current, secondary final-vs-frozen-current, and domain-local-current-vs-frozen-current; no tuning is permitted between cache freeze and outcome

stage0_parity.required: outer-0 Stage-1 first and repeat independently reproduce every overlapping Stage-0 model, V_0j score/choice, current T_0 OOF/gate/activation, focused A_00 cohort/model/score/choice, and V_00 RRF hash

resource_revision.revised_estimate: approximately 105-130 minutes per pass and 3.5-4.3 hours total on the measured host
resource_revision.effect_on_protocol: resource estimate only; no reduced fits, reused models, parallel workers, changed batch semantics, changed rounds, or changed thread count
